title: Antarctica's 2026 Ozone Hole: Large, Yet Healing

beats.narration: The Antarctic ozone hole grew unusually large in twenty twenty-six. Does that mean the ozone layer has stopped healing?

visual.title: ANTARCTICA'S OZONE HOLE
visual.body: 2026: a large hole, but a more complex story

beats.narration: NASA and NOAA report an average area of twenty-five million square kilometers during peak season: seventh largest in forty-eight years.
On September eighteenth, the hole reached twenty-seven point one million square kilometers. Ozone hole means thinning, not an actual empty space.
This NASA animation follows changing ozone above Antarctica through the winter of twenty twenty-six. Watch the original dates as the colors shift.

beats.narration: The hole was large, yet recovery continues. Thanks to the Montreal Protocol, scientists still expect Antarctic ozone to recover around the twenty-seventies.
